metaDescription: Biscuit and plate joiners compared by motor, fence design, depth stops, bevel range and cordless options for aligning panels, frames and edge joints.
expertTake: The Makita PJ7000 is the best biscuit joiner for most woodworkers: a 5.6 amp, 11,000 RPM motor, a pivot fence with stops at 0, 45 and 90 degrees and one-touch depth settings. The DeWalt DW682K is the pick for a dual rack-and-pinion fence that keeps the blade parallel. The WEN JN8504 is the value pick. If you want the finest alignment and can pay for it, the Lamello Classic X is the benchmark.
introParagraphs: A biscuit joiner, or plate joiner, cuts a crescent-shaped slot in each of two mating edges. A thin, compressed beechwood biscuit glued into the pair swells with the glue and locks the boards into alignment. It is a fast way to align panels for a tabletop, strengthen a miter and register a cabinet face frame.
Fence design, depth stops and motor quality decide how accurately the slots line up.

products.name: Makita PJ7000 Plate Joiner

specList.label: Fence
specList.value: Cast aluminum pivot, stops at 0, 45 and 90 degrees

products.description:
The PJ7000 pairs a 5.6 amp, 11,000 RPM motor with a cast aluminum pivot fence that has positive stops at 0, 45 and 90 degrees. Six one-touch depth settings cover the common biscuit sizes, including #0, #10 and #20.

A cast aluminum fence stays flat and stiff, which matters because the fence is the reference for every slot. The positive stops let you cut slots for butt joints, miter joints and edge joints without measuring angles, and the depth stops let you change biscuit size by turning a knob. Compared with the DeWalt DW682K, the Makita has less motor, at 5.6 amps against 6.5, but a more convenient pivot fence.

It is a corded, reliable tool with a straightforward design. Keep the blade sharp and the plunge slides clean, since sawdust packs the slots and makes the plunge stiff. Mark the joint with a pencil tick across both boards, set the fence to the same face each time and plunge firmly against the stop. A biscuit slot should never be cut closer than about 1 inch from the end of a board.
products.bestFor: Furniture and cabinet makers who want a dependable general-purpose plate joiner.
pros: Cast aluminum pivot fence with 0, 45 and 90 stops
cons: No dedicated vacuum port on the base design

products.name: DEWALT DW682K 6.5 Amp Biscuit Joiner Kit

specList.label: Fence
specList.value: Dual rack and pinion, one-piece, 0 to 90 degrees

products.description:
The DW682K has a 6.5 amp, 10,000 RPM motor and a dual rack-and-pinion fence system that keeps the blade and fence parallel. The one-piece integral fence tilts from 0 to 90 degrees, and a retractable 45 degree notch helps with depth spots.

Parallel is the key word, because a fence that tilts even slightly out of parallel cuts slots at a skewed angle and the boards do not line up. The dual rack and pinion design is how DeWalt prevents that. A strong motor with more amps than the Makita PJ7000's 5.6 amps cuts the hardest woods smoothly, though 10,000 RPM is slightly slower than the Makita's 11,000.

The kit includes the case. Replace the blade when it dulls and check the fence for play after rough handling. Because the fence stays parallel, you can set the height with the thickness stops and cut matching slots in both boards without re-measuring. Keep the dust chute clear, since a packed chute makes the plunge feel gritty.
products.bestFor: Woodworkers who value a fence that stays parallel and a strong motor.
pros: Dual rack and pinion keeps blade and fence parallel
cons: Slower 10,000 RPM spindle than the Makita

products.name: Lamello Classic X Biscuit Joiner
products.description:
The Lamello Classic X is the joiner that created the category, with a 780 watt motor and CNC machined parts that keep slots parallel over years of use. A swiveling base plate front stop and stop square sit flush on the sides for easy positioning on an edge.

Accuracy comes from the guidance system, which is built to hold tolerance long after cheaper tools develop play. For furniture makers who cut thousands of slots, that is the whole point. The cost reflects it, and the Lamello sits well above every other pick here. Compared with the Makita PJ7000, it is a more refined, more expensive tool, with a lot of professional features.

It makes sense only if you use a plate joiner constantly. For occasional work, the Makita or DeWalt gives nearly the same result at far lower cost. Lamello also sells accessories for edge-to-edge joining and a range of other connectors, which extends what the tool can do. Expect to buy blades and spare stops from the maker rather than a generic supplier.
products.bestFor: Professional furniture and cabinet shops that use a joiner daily.
pros: Swiveling front stop and flush stop square
cons: Priced far above the other joiners

products.name: DEWALT DCW682B 20V MAX XR Brushless Biscuit Joiner (Tool Only)
products.description:
The DCW682B is a cordless brushless biscuit joiner with a dual rack-and-pinion fence and tool-free depth, height and bevel adjustments. A depth selection knob switches between #0, #10 and #20 biscuits.

Cordless plate joining is useful on site, where you may be installing cabinets or assembling a built-in with no power nearby. The brushless motor provides consistent cutting for common biscuit sizes, and the dual rack-and-pinion fence carries over the accuracy of the corded DW682K. The tradeoff is cost and battery weight.

It is a bare tool, so you need 20V MAX batteries. A 4.0Ah or 5.0Ah pack gives plenty of slots. Biscuits are sold separately. Because it is a bare tool, plan for at least one 4.0Ah pack, and keep a spare charged. Biscuits are cheap, so buy a box of each size before you start.
products.bestFor: Site carpenters and cabinet installers on 20V MAX.
pros: Tool-free depth, height and bevel adjustments
cons: Tool only, battery and biscuits extra
Heavier and costlier than corded models

products.name: WEN JN8504 8.5 Amp Plate and Biscuit Joiner with Case

specList.label: Fence
specList.value: Adjustable for any height or angle

products.description:
The WEN JN8504 is an 8.5 amp plate joiner with an adjustable fence that creates slots at any height or angle, preset stops for #0, #10 and #20 biscuits, and a case with biscuits in the box. It is the least expensive joiner in the guide.

The 8.5 amp motor is the strongest rating here on paper, but a motor rating is not the same as slot accuracy. The fence and plunge mechanism determine alignment, and on a budget tool these are looser than on the Makita or DeWalt. The included biscuits mean you can start immediately.

Test slots on scrap and check the fence for play. It is a good fit for hobbyists who join panels occasionally. Use a block of scrap to test the slot position before cutting your project. A budget fence can drift, so lock it and recheck after every few joints.
products.bestFor: Hobbyists who want a complete low-cost kit.
pros: Least expensive joiner in the guide
Preset stops for common biscuit sizes
cons: Looser fence and plunge than premium tools

buyingCriteria.explanation: The fence references every slot, so it must be flat and parallel to the blade. The DeWalt DW682K and DCW682B use a dual rack-and-pinion fence, and the Makita PJ7000 uses a cast aluminum pivot fence with stops. A fence with play cuts crooked slots. Check fence travel by hand. Wiggle the fence in your hand before you buy; if you feel play, it will show in your slots.

Biscuits come in #0, #10 and #20 sizes, and the depth must match. The Makita has six one-touch stops, the WEN has presets and the DeWalt cordless has a selector knob. Easy depth changes save time on a project that mixes sizes. Check which biscuit sizes you will use most before choosing a tool with a knob or presets.

Motors run from 5.6 amps on the Makita to 8.5 amps on the WEN, with spindle speeds from 10,000 to 12,000 RPM. A bigger motor holds speed in hard woods, but spindle speed and blade quality matter for clean slots. The Lamello lists a 780 watt motor. A bigger motor helps in oak and maple, but a sharp blade helps more.

Tilting fences set slots for miter joints. The Makita has stops at 0, 45 and 90 degrees, and the DeWalt tilts 0 to 90. Positive stops save fiddling with a protractor. If you cut many miters, buy a tool with positive stops at 45 degrees.

The Lamello Classic X uses CNC machined parts and a long-life guidance system. Cheaper tools develop slop in the plunge slides. For production work, tolerance matters more than motor size. Ask how long the tool will hold tolerance, not only what it costs today.

Corded joiners like the Makita PJ7000 never run down. The DeWalt DCW682B is cordless and brushless, which suits site work. A cordless joiner costs more and needs batteries. If you already own batteries, cordless is easy to justify for site work.

specDecoder.meaning: Biscuits are #0, #10 and #20, in increasing length. Larger biscuits give more holding area and need deeper slots. It is the number to check before you compare any other figure.
specDecoder.watchFor: A #20 biscuit in a narrow rail can break out the side.

specDecoder.meaning: Amps are the motor's current draw. More amps hold spindle speed in hard woods. It is the number to check before you compare any other figure.
specDecoder.watchFor: Slot accuracy comes from the fence and plunge, not the amp rating.

specDecoder.meaning: RPM is the blade speed, typically 10,000 to 12,000. Faster blades leave a cleaner slot edge. It is the number to check before you compare any other figure.
specDecoder.watchFor: A dull blade at high RPM burns the slot.

specDecoder.meaning: A rack-and-pinion fence moves with two gears so both ends travel the same amount. That keeps the fence parallel to the blade. It is the number to check before you compare any other figure.
specDecoder.watchFor: Not all fences advertised as adjustable stay parallel.

specDecoder.meaning: Positive stops are detents at set angles. They let you return to 45 or 90 degrees without measuring. It is the number to check before you compare any other figure.
specDecoder.watchFor: Check stops for wear on used tools.

cards.text: Look for a parallel fence, repeatable depth and a stable base so slots line up across a wide panel.

maintenance.why: A dull blade burns and tears. Replace it with a carbide-tipped blade. Skipping it is a common reason joints come out misaligned.
Dust makes the plunge stiff. Wipe and lubricate lightly. Skipping it is a common reason joints come out misaligned.
A fence out of parallel cuts crooked slots. Test on scrap. Skipping it is a common reason joints come out misaligned.
A full bag blocks the chute. Skipping it is a common reason joints come out misaligned.
Damp biscuits swell early. Keep them in a sealed bag. Skipping it is a common reason joints come out misaligned.

faq.q: What is a biscuit joiner used for?
faq.a: It aligns boards and strengthens joints by cutting slots for biscuits. It is common in panel glue-ups and face frames. Slots in plywood edges also line up cabinet boxes, which is why cabinet shops use them.

They add alignment and some strength, but they are not a structural joint like a mortise and tenon. A biscuit swells when it meets glue, and that swelling gives the joint its alignment, so use water-based glue.

Use #20 for most panels and #10 for narrow stock. #0 is for thin parts. Choose the biscuit by the thickness of the stock, leaving at least 1/4 inch of wood on each side. Matching biscuit length to joint length keeps the slot from weakening the board.

faq.q: Do I need a biscuit joiner or a Domino?
faq.a: A Domino cuts mortises and is stronger. A biscuit joiner is cheaper and fine for alignment. A Domino is a different machine, and the two tools complement each other for loose-tenon joinery.

faq.q: Can I use one on plywood?
faq.a: Yes, plate joiners work in plywood for cabinet boxes. Keep slots away from the surface veneer. Keep slots away from the finished surface, since a swollen biscuit can telegraph through thin veneer.

faq.q: How do I avoid misaligned slots?
faq.a: Reference every slot from the same face. Mark the layout and clamp the work. Dry-fit every joint before gluing so you can fix any slot that does not line up.
